arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'src/pydicom/encaps.py').resolve()
try:
 module = importlib.import_module('pydicom.encaps')
except Exception as import_error:
 traceback=import_error.__traceback__
 while traceback is not None:
  file=traceback.tb_frame.f_globals.get('__file__')
  if file and Path(file).resolve()==expected:
   print('source_binding', str(expected), 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(expected.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'actual_import_failure_frame')
  traceback=traceback.tb_next
 raise
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
import io
from pydicom.encaps import EncapsulatedBuffer
b1 = io.BytesIO(bytes(8))
b2 = io.BytesIO(bytes([1]) * 8)
buf = EncapsulatedBuffer([b1, b2])
print('open_closed', buf.closed)
assert buf.closed is False
b1.close()
print('one_closed', buf.closed)
assert buf.closed is True, 'aggregate must report closed when any item buffer is released'
b2.close()
assert buf.closed is True
print('encaps_closed_ok')

PYREPLAY
